g.text: NOD2 RECOGNITION — How the Protein Sees Bacteria
Full NOD2 structure with domain coloring
Magenta spheres = drug binding site in LRR
✓ Normal function: Recognizes MDP → triggers immune response
Drug binding site located in LRR domain (green region)
✗ Crohn's Disease Risk: 3× higher | Impaired bacterial sensing
Mutation affects binding through ALLOSTERIC mechanism (long-range)
DRUG BINDING COMPARISON — Which Drug Works for Mutant Patients?
Cyan spheres = Bufadienolide in LRR pocket
Orange spheres = Febuxostat in LRR pocket
Both drugs bind same pocket, but Febuxostat is sensitive to
allosteric changes caused by R702W mutation 79.4 Å away
SIGNALING CASCADE — From Detection to Inflammation
Bufadienolide maintains strong binding (-9.0 kcal/mol) even with R702W mutation
→ First mutation-resistant NOD2 modulator identified for Crohn's disease patients

svg.text: Methods: AlphaFold2 structure prediction | GNINA deep learning docking | GROMACS molecular dynamics | FEP+ free energy calculations | XGBoost ML classifier
Deep Learning Guided Discovery and FEP Validation of NOD2 Binders for the R702W Crohn's Disease Mutation
